data.name: Victorin
data.gender_notes: Victorin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'victor' meaning 'conqueror'. In Christian tradition, the name Victorin is often associated with the early Christian martyr, Saint Victorinus, who was tortured and beheaded for his faith in Rome during the reign of Emperor Diocletian. The name Victorin carries the meaning “Conquering” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Victorin usually hope their child will grow to embody conquering and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strength, courage, and unwavering faith.
data.etymology: Victorin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conquering.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Victorin total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: ויקטורין הוא שם שמקורו ברומי, נגזר מלטינית ומשמעותו 'נצחון' או 'מנצח'. השם ויקטורין קשור לנצחון הרוחני והאלוהי, והוא משמש כזכר לנצחון של האל על פני הרוע והחטא. השם מראה על השפעה רומית-נוצרית וקשר למסורת הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Βικτωρίν
in_greek.long_meaning: Βικτωρίν είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη Victor, που σημαίνει 'νικητής' ή 'αυτός που κερδίζει'. Το όνομα συνδέεται με τη νίκη επί του κακού και την πνευματική νίκη που έρχεται μέσω της πίστης. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Βικτωρίν συμβολίζει τη δύναμη και τη νίκη που δίνει ο Θεός στους πιστούς.

Saint Victorinus' courageous testimony inspires admiration and imitation as a model of the unwavering commitment to one's faith, even amidst overwhelming adversity. The name Victorin is a reminder of the power of God to give strength and serenity in difficult times, ultimately resulting in triumph over adversity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Victorin signifies victory in hardship or tribulation. This name inspires strength and resilience in the face of adversity. It is a reminder that, with faith, we can overcome even the greatest challenges.

historical_references.reference: Saint Victorinus of Mariborus, also known as Victorinus of Pettau, was a bishop in the Roman Empire during the late 3rd and early 4th centuries. He is believed to have lived from around 270 to 304 AD and is considered one of the most important early Christian writers from the eastern part of the empire. He was born in Pannonia, a province of the Roman Empire in present-day Hungary, and is best known for his works 'De idolatria' and 'Ad Autolycum', which were influential in the early Christian debates against paganism.
historical_references.context: Early Christian writer and bishop from the eastern part of the Roman Empire

historical_references.reference: Victorinus of Aquitaine, also known as Victor of Marseille, was a Christian bishop and theologian who lived in the late 4th century AD. He was born in Aquitania, a province of the Roman Empire in present-day southwestern France, and is best known for his work 'De Antichristo', in which he identified the Antichrist as a historical figure who would come before the end times. He was also a prominent teacher and played a significant role in the development of Christian theology during the period of the early Church.
historical_references.context: Christian bishop and theologian from the western part of the Roman Empire
